title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 42
paragraphs: Adrastus answered: “O king, otherwise I would not have been going out to any such contest of valor. For one thing, it is not fitting that a man suffering such great misfortune as mine should seek the company of prosperous companions, and for another I have no desire for it, and for many reasons I would have kept myself away. But now, since you are pressing me, and I ought to gratify you—for I am bound to repay you with kindness—I am ready to do this. Expect, therefore, that your son, whom you command me to protect, will return to you unhurt, so far as his protector may be able to keep him safe.”
